verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own docs say a new account imports the SSH and GPG keys from your GitHub profile, skipping keys it cannot use. Forges keep GPG keys mainly to verify signatures, which suggests signing support, but no evidence shows signatures being checked or a verified badge on commits. missing for 10: documentation of commit signature verification, a verified/unverified indicator on commits, adding GPG/SSH signing keys directly (not only via GitHub import), SSH-signature support details, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
